careers.name: Software Developer
careers.description: Software developers design, build, and maintain computer programs and applications. They turn ideas into working software that people use every day.
careers.education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field. Online bootcamps also work.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy solving puzzles or logical problems?
Are you comfortable spending long hours on a computer?
Do you like learning new tools and technologies?

careers.name: Nurse
careers.description: Nurses care for patients, assist doctors, and provide emotional support to families. They are the backbone of any hospital or clinic.
careers.education: B.Sc Nursing or GNM diploma. Must be registered with a nursing council.

quiz.question: Do you stay calm in stressful situations?
Do you enjoy helping people directly?
Are you comfortable with blood or medical procedures?

careers.name: Graphic Designer
careers.description: Graphic designers create visual content for websites, ads, logos, and social media. They combine art and technology to communicate ideas.
careers.education: Bachelor's in Design (B.Des) or a diploma in graphic design. A strong portfolio matters most.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy drawing or visualising ideas?
Do you notice colours and layouts in everyday things?
Are you open to feedback on your creative work?

careers.name: Electrician
careers.description: Electricians install, maintain, and repair electrical wiring and equipment. It's a skilled trade with strong demand and self-employment potential.
careers.education: ITI certificate in Electrician trade. Apprenticeship improves job prospects.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy working with your hands?
Are you good at following safety rules?
Do you like fixing things when they break?

careers.name: Teacher
careers.description: Teachers educate students in schools and colleges. They plan lessons, explain concepts, and shape the next generation.
careers.education: Bachelor's degree + B.Ed (Bachelor of Education). TET exam for government schools.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy explaining things to others?
Do you have patience with people who learn slowly?
Do you like being around young people?

careers.name: Accountant
careers.description: Accountants manage financial records, prepare tax returns, and help businesses stay compliant. Attention to detail is key.
careers.education: B.Com + CA or CMA. Even a basic accounting diploma can get you started.

quiz.question: Are you good with numbers and calculations?
Do you pay attention to small details?
Do you like organising information systematically?

careers.name: Social Worker
careers.description: Social workers help individuals and communities solve problems. They work in NGOs, government agencies, and hospitals.
careers.education: Bachelor's in Social Work (BSW) or Master's (MSW).

quiz.question: Do you feel strongly about social issues?
Are you a good listener?
Do you want to make a difference in your community?

careers.name: Data Analyst
careers.description: Data analysts collect, clean, and interpret data to help companies make decisions. It's one of the fastest-growing careers.
careers.education: Bachelor's in Statistics, Math, or Computer Science. Certifications in Excel, SQL, and Python help.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy finding patterns in information?
Are you comfortable with spreadsheets and charts?
Do you like proving a point with evidence?

careers.name: Chef
careers.description: Chefs prepare food in restaurants, hotels, and catering services. Creativity and stamina are both important.
careers.education: Diploma in Culinary Arts or hotel management. Apprenticeship in a kitchen is very valuable.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy cooking and experimenting with food?
Can you work well under time pressure?
Do you like making people happy through what you create?

careers.name: Plumber
careers.description: Plumbers install and repair water and drainage systems. It's a stable trade with the option to start your own business.
careers.education: ITI certificate in Plumbing. On-the-job training is essential.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy practical, hands-on work?
Are you good at diagnosing problems?
Are you willing to work in different locations?

careers.name: Content Writer
careers.description: Content writers create articles, blogs, and marketing copy for websites and brands. Good writers are always in demand.
careers.education: Any bachelor's degree. A portfolio of published work matters more than the degree.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy writing and expressing ideas in words?
Are you good at researching new topics?
Can you explain complex things simply?

careers.name: Entrepreneur
careers.description: Entrepreneurs start and run their own businesses. They identify problems, build solutions, and manage teams.
careers.salary: Highly variable — from losses to crores per year
careers.education: No specific degree required. Business courses and mentorship help.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy taking calculated risks?
Are you comfortable being in charge?
Do you bounce back quickly from failure?

careers.name: Civil Engineer
careers.description: Civil engineers design and supervise construction of roads, bridges, buildings, and dams. They shape the physical world around us.
careers.education: B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering. GATE for M.Tech or PSU jobs.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy designing or building things?
Are you comfortable with maths and physics?
Do you like working on large-scale projects?

careers.name: Mechanical Engineer
careers.description: Mechanical engineers design, build, and test machines and mechanical systems. They work in automotive, aerospace, and manufacturing.
careers.education: B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering. GATE for higher studies.

quiz.question: Are you fascinated by machines and engines?
Do you enjoy hands-on problem solving?
Are you comfortable with physics and mechanics?

careers.name: Architect
careers.description: Architects design buildings and spaces that are functional, safe, and beautiful. They blend art with engineering.
careers.education: B.Arch (5-year degree). NATA or JEE Paper 2 entrance exam.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy drawing and designing spaces?
Are you good at visualising 3D objects?
Do you balance creativity with practical constraints?

careers.name: Pilot
careers.description: Pilots fly commercial aircraft, cargo planes, or private jets. It's a high-responsibility career with excellent pay.
careers.education: 10+2 with Physics & Maths, then CPL (Commercial Pilot License) training.

quiz.question: Are you comfortable with high responsibility?
Do you have strong focus and quick reflexes?
Are you okay with frequent travel?

careers.name: Ethical Hacker
careers.description: Ethical hackers test systems for security flaws to help companies protect their data from real attackers.
careers.education: B.Tech in CS/IT or certifications like CEH, OSCP.

quiz.question: Are you curious about how systems work?
Do you enjoy finding weaknesses in puzzles?
Do you want to protect people from cybercrime?

careers.name: Doctor
careers.description: Doctors diagnose and treat illnesses. It's one of the most respected careers, requiring years of study and dedication.
careers.education: MBBS (5.5 years) after NEET. Specialisation via MD/MS.

quiz.question: Do you want to help people heal?
Can you handle long hours of study and work?
Do you stay calm in emergencies?

careers.name: Pharmacist
careers.description: Pharmacists prepare and dispense medicines, advise patients, and ensure drug safety. They work in hospitals, pharmacies, and pharma companies.
careers.education: B.Pharm (4 years) or D.Pharm (2 years). GPAT for M.Pharm.

quiz.question: Are you good with chemistry and biology?
Do you pay attention to detail?
Do you enjoy helping people with their health?

careers.name: Physiotherapist
careers.description: Physiotherapists help patients recover from injuries and surgeries through exercise and manual therapy.
careers.education: BPT (Bachelor of Physiotherapy, 4.5 years).

quiz.question: Do you enjoy working directly with people?
Are you interested in how the body moves?
Are you patient with slow recovery processes?

careers.name: Biotechnologist
careers.description: Biotechnologists use living cells to develop medicines, vaccines, and environmentally friendly products.
careers.education: B.Tech / B.Sc in Biotechnology. M.Sc or Ph.D. for research roles.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy lab work and experiments?
Are you curious about how living things work?
Do you want to solve health or environmental problems?

careers.name: Lab Technician
careers.description: Lab technicians perform medical tests that help doctors diagnose diseases. They work in hospitals and diagnostic labs.
careers.education: DMLT (Diploma in Medical Lab Technology) or B.Sc MLT.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy working in a lab?
Are you careful with procedures?
Do you want to be part of a medical team?

careers.name: Chartered Accountant
careers.description: Chartered Accountants audit finances, file taxes, and advise businesses on money matters. It's a prestigious, high-paying career.
careers.education: CA Foundation → Intermediate → Final. Practical training required.

quiz.question: Are you excellent with numbers?
Do you enjoy solving financial problems?
Are you willing to study hard for years?

careers.name: Banker
careers.description: Bankers handle customer accounts, loans, and investments. Government bank jobs offer security and good benefits.
careers.education: Any bachelor's degree. IBPS PO, SBI PO, or RBI exams for government banks.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy working with money and numbers?
Are you comfortable talking to customers?
Do you want a stable government job?

careers.name: Marketing Manager
careers.description: Marketing managers plan campaigns to promote products and build brands. They combine creativity with strategy.
careers.education: BBA / B.Com + MBA in Marketing.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy convincing people about ideas?
Are you creative and strategic?
Do you keep up with social media trends?

careers.name: Company Secretary
careers.description: Company Secretaries ensure companies follow legal and regulatory rules. They work closely with boards and directors.
careers.education: CS Foundation → Executive → Professional. Usually paired with B.Com or LLB.

quiz.question: Are you interested in business law?
Do you pay attention to rules and regulations?
Are you organised and detail-oriented?

careers.name: Stock Broker
careers.description: Stock brokers buy and sell shares for clients. It's a fast-paced career for those who understand markets.
careers.education: Bachelor's in Finance/Commerce. NISM certification required.

quiz.question: Are you interested in the stock market?
Can you handle financial risk?
Do you stay calm under pressure?

careers.name: Lawyer
careers.description: Lawyers represent clients in legal matters, argue cases, and advise on rights and obligations.
careers.education: BA LLB (5 years) or LLB (3 years). CLAT for top law schools.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy debating and arguing?
Are you good at reading and interpreting rules?
Do you want to fight for justice?

careers.name: Journalist
careers.description: Journalists report news, investigate stories, and inform the public. They work in newspapers, TV, and digital media.
careers.education: Bachelor's in Journalism / Mass Communication.

quiz.question: Are you curious about current events?
Do you enjoy writing and storytelling?
Can you work under deadlines?

careers.name: Psychologist
careers.description: Psychologists study human behaviour and help people with mental health, relationships, and personal growth.
careers.education: BA/B.Sc Psychology + MA/M.Sc + M.Phil or PhD for clinical practice.

quiz.question: Are you a good listener?
Do you find human behaviour fascinating?
Can you keep sensitive information confidential?

careers.name: Civil Servant (IAS/IPS)
careers.description: IAS and IPS officers run government administration and police. It's one of India's most prestigious careers.
careers.education: Any bachelor's degree + UPSC Civil Services Exam.

quiz.question: Do you want to serve the country?
Are you good at reading and analysis?
Can you lead teams and take tough decisions?

careers.name: Fashion Designer
careers.description: Fashion designers create clothing and accessories. They combine art, culture, and business to shape what people wear.
careers.education: B.Des from NIFT, NID, or similar institutes.

quiz.question: Do you follow fashion trends?
Are you creative with colours and fabrics?
Do you enjoy sketching and designing?

careers.name: Welder
careers.description: Welders join metal parts using heat. They work in construction, manufacturing, and shipbuilding.
careers.education: ITI certificate in Welding. Skill certification boosts pay.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy hands-on work?
Are you good at following safety rules?
Are you physically fit?

careers.name: Automobile Technician
careers.description: Automobile technicians repair and service cars and bikes. Demand is high with the rise of electric vehicles.
careers.education: ITI in Motor Mechanic Vehicle (MMV) or diploma in Automobile Engineering.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy working on vehicles?
Are you good at diagnosing problems?
Do you like tinkering with machines?

careers.name: Beautician
careers.description: Beauticians provide skincare, hair, and makeup services. Many run their own salons or freelance.
careers.education: Beauty courses from private institutes. Certification from recognized bodies helps.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy making people look good?
Are you creative with styles and colours?
Do you enjoy meeting new people?

careers.name: IT Support Technician
careers.description: IT support technicians install, maintain, and fix computer systems and networks in offices and schools.
careers.education: Diploma in IT or certifications like CompTIA A+, CCNA.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy fixing computer problems?
Are you patient with non-technical users?
Do you like learning new software?

careers.name: Carpenter
careers.description: Carpenters build and repair wooden furniture, doors, and structures. Skilled carpenters can run their own workshops.
careers.education: ITI in Carpentry or apprenticeship under an experienced carpenter.

quiz.question: Do you enjoy working with wood?
Are you good with measurements?
Do you like creating things with your hands?

reviews.comment: This career card was really helpful! I never knew coding could be for someone like me. The salary info gave me hope.
I liked that it showed ITI as an option. Not everyone can afford college. But I wish there were more details about apprenticeship.
The mini-quiz helped me understand if nursing is right for me. I answered yes to all and felt confident!

scholarships.name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS)
scholarships.eligibility: Class 12 passed with 80%+ marks. Family income below ₹8 lakh per year.
scholarships.description: For meritorious students from economically weaker sections pursuing undergraduate courses.

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
scholarships.eligibility: Girl students in first year of technical degree/diploma. Family income below ₹8 lakh.
scholarships.description: Encourages girls to pursue technical education by covering tuition, books, and other expenses.

scholarships.name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC
scholarships.eligibility: SC/ST/OBC students pursuing post-matric education. Family income limits apply.
scholarships.description: Financial assistance for SC/ST/OBC students to continue education after Class 10.

scholarships.name: Saksham Scholarship for Differently-Abled
scholarships.eligibility: Students with 40%+ disability in technical degree/diploma. Family income below ₹8 lakh.
scholarships.description: Supports differently-abled students pursuing technical education.

scholarships.name: UP Scholarship (Class 9-12)
scholarships.eligibility: Students in Class 9-12 in Uttar Pradesh. General/SC/ST/OBC/Minority categories.
scholarships.description: State scholarship for students in Uttar Pradesh from Class 9 to 12.

scholarships.name: Reliance Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate students in select institutions. Merit + need-based.
scholarships.description: Private scholarship for meritorious students from low-income families.
